summary: Frontend mobile regression retest completed for setup, named history, theme toggle, toss, active scoring controls, rules modal, and landscape layout.

issues: Theme toggle does not change the rendered page palette/background; dark card and content surfaces remain unchanged after toggling.

action_items: Apply the light theme palette consistently to content cards, text, controls, board/history surfaces, and modal, not only SafeAreaView/appbar/title.
Retest theme toggle and persistence after palette update.
critical_code_review_comments: themeDark is only applied to safe, appbar, and title styles; most screen styles still hardcode the dark palette.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, setup -> toss -> active passed with Alice/Bob. Due stayed at 0 on decrement; opponent men capped at 9; queen completion created 'Alice won board' history; rules modal opened; 844x390 had no horizontal overflow. Theme toggle click worked but computed body background did not change and screenshot remained predominantly dark.
rca_of_issue: The toggle updates themeDark state, but styles are static C constants. Only SafeAreaView/appbar background and title color reference !themeDark; all cards, content, controls, board, modal, and most text retain dark constants.
